name: hatchet_flight
notes: A bearded hand-hatchet (steel bit with bright edge and blood streaks, wrapped wooden haft) tumbling end over end, one whole clockwise turn per 8-frame loop (1.5 turns/s), a tapered air smear trailing the blade and a faint arc off the haft end. 27 px long = 0.49 m. Anchor = spin pivot (near the head). Drawn facing +x (spins forward when moving +x; mirror for a left throw).
